title: `getServerState` doesn't correctly handle exceptions and crashes entire node server
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

`getServerState` doesn't correctly handle exceptions in search client (e.g. `ECONNREFUSED`), which causes it to hang forever, and crashes the entire node server if there's no defined handler for `'unhandledRejection'`.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Live reproduction:**

This is the minimal Remix reproduction:

https://stackblitz.com/edit/node-vn7ere?file=app/entry.server.tsx

Steps to test:

1. Run the StackBlitz WebContainer - it should crash
2. Uncomment code in `app/entry.server.tsx`, which defines `process.on('unhandledRejection', ...)` handler and restart everything. Now the server should not crash, but `getServerState` will still hang forever
3. The workaround is to add `Promise.race`: see `index.tsx`

Note that this bug is not specific to Remix - I was able to reproduce it in Next as well.

## 💭 Expected behavior

`getServerState` should correctly propagate exceptions so that they can be catched. `unhandledRejection` handler should not be required.

## 🖥 Screenshots

## Environment

* React InstantSearch Hooks version: \[6.38.1]
* React version: \[e.g. 17.0.2]
* Browser: \[N/A]
* OS: \[Linux]
* Node version: v16.14.2 and v18.12.0
